_comment: Transcribed from PrivateDataCoder.swift (rules_version 1). Regexes use ICU syntax. The cases in credential_cases.json (private_data) are the oracle. The Python twin is services/capture_core/private_data.py.

key.format: 64 ASCII hex digits (32 bytes). Anything else gives keyless coding.
key.code_hash: first 2 bytes of the MAC as 4 lower-case hex digits

calling_code_lookup: Try the first 3 digits, then 2, then 1. No match gives INT.
email_domain_type: webmail if the domain is in webmail_domains; other if the last label is gov, edu, mil, int or org, or the domain has 3+ labels, the second-last is gov, edu or ac and the last has 2 letters; otherwise corp.
overlap_rule: Collect all spans, drop any that overlap an existing [CODE·...] span, sort by start, then priority, then longer first, then take spans left to right skipping overlaps.

checked_field_labels.rule: After these labels only a value that passes the partita IVA check (optional IT prefix, 11 digits, Luhn) or the codice fiscale check is coded.

label_regex_template.field: (?i)(?<![A-Za-z0-9])(?:<words sorted by length desc then alphabetically, spaces inside a word become [ \t]+, other characters escaped>)(?![A-Za-z0-9])[ \t]*[:=][ \t]*

label_only_value_lookahead: A label alone on a line codes the next non-empty line, looking at most 2 lines ahead, when that line passes looks_like(kind).

looks_like.all: false when the line already starts with a code

rules.if: length 16 and (first two digits 51-55 or first four 2221-2720)
length>=16 and (first four 6011, first two 65, or first three 644-649)
length>=14 and (first three 300-305, first four 3095, or first two 36, 38, 39)

card_brands.lengths: 13 to 19 digits, checked in this order; a 13-digit Visa is not a brand
card_brands.luhn: required in free text; labelled fields use brand OTHER when no rule fits

codice_fiscale_odd_values.rule: Sum over the first 15 characters: odd positions (1st, 3rd...) use this table; even positions use the digit value or letter index (A=0). The 16th character must equal letter index (sum mod 26).

normal_forms.CARD: digits only (or upper-case alphanumerics if none)
normal_forms.PHONE: digits only with country code: '+' prefix keeps digits; '00' prefix (more than 4 digits) drops the zeros; 8-10 digit Italian mobile starting 3 or landline starting 0 gets '39' in front; else digits as typed with country INT
normal_forms.TAXID: upper-case alphanumerics; an 'IT' + 11 digit value drops the 'IT'

labels_in_codes.IBAN: country (first two letters) or ?? when absent
labels_in_codes.EMAIL: domain type, or 'other' when the value has no @
labels_in_codes.PHONE: country from calling code (IT for Italian local numbers, INT when unknown)
labels_in_codes.TAXID: IT, or the two-letter country of a foreign tax ID whose prefix is an IBAN country

count_string: KIND=n pairs sorted by kind, comma separated, only kinds above 0, e.g. EMAIL=2,IBAN=1. Counts follow the codes present in the text, whoever made them.
